What is quantum mechanics? In this video, we explain quantum physics in ridiculously simple words — from superposition and wave-particle duality to quantum tunneling and the uncertainty principle. Learn how quantum mechanics differs from classical physics and why it is the foundation of everything in our universe.
Whether you’re a student, a science enthusiast, or just curious about the quantum world, this beginner-friendly animated explainer breaks down one of the most fascinating subjects in modern physics.
